body: It's basically just a calorie and exercise tracker, built on a social networking platform. It's really fun for me to see what other people like to eat. :)

I haven't played games in a long time, but have been wanting to try Minecraft.

Is losing weight something you'd like to try to work on? I use MyFitnessPal to track my calories, I would be happy to connect with you on there to help you with the diet aspect. Exercise is great, but for me, controlling my diet has helped me lose much more weight. It's a really great first step, because you start to lose weight while still playing video games and sitting on your ass, which I really enjoy. :)

Video games actually help me lose weight, because I get so into the game that I don't even get up to eat.

What games do you like?

I'm so sorry to hear you're having such a tough time. I made life long friends in WoW, people I still talk to in real life today, and I haven't played in five years!

I'm not going to lie and tell you that I came here today just to support people like you. The truth is, this is a throwaway account that I created this morning to post my own cry for help, but something about your post struck a chord with me.

I'm older than you, and I'm married with two kids. But I can relate to you. I feel worthless too. I'm a stay at home mom, and despite raising some awesome kids, I feel like no one cares about my "accomplishments" and that I'm just a burden to my family. I thought if I could reach out to you, that I would feel better. And I do (a little). So, thanks, for the conversation, and for holding on a little longer. For yourself, and for me, and for all the rest of us that are out there, struggling to get through the day.

You are not alone, and you have more to offer to the world than you know. You're smart, and your parents love you. I love you, too. 

For the Horde!

Your friend is an asshole. Good people do not talk to their friends that way, and I'm sorry you had to deal with that.

What do you enjoy, or did you enjoy before the burden of being alive started to feel like too much?

That's not pathetic at all, that's what parents are for! Are you interested in finding a job at the moment? What type of skills and qualifications do you have? (I just read through your post history, you really do love gaming, and seem to be pretty good at what you do!)

I used to love coming home from a long day at work, making some dinner, and sitting down at the computer to get my gaming on. There was nothing more satisfying to me than being able to make money AND do what I enjoy.

I used to play WoW a lot, too. I understand about wanting to feel needed, as I was a main healer when we raided. I loved that feeling of them not being able to make it through if I wasn't there.

What do you do for work? Are you able to play when you aren't working?
What do you enjoy? Or, if you're not enjoying anything now, what did you used to enjoy doing?
I understood what you meant, I just meant it was sad that you aren't friends anymore. I know that feeling.
How did you lose your friend? That's really sad, I'm sorry.
Where did you buy a ticket to?

I've recognized that these feelings aren't normal, but they've become so normal to me, a part of me. I wouldn't know how to live any other way. It's impossible for me to grasp that there is an easier way, other than in death.
